question: Which of the following instruments works on the principle of the magnification of the small movement of the plunger or stylus that is converted into a rotary motion of the pointer on a circular scale?
solution:
The correct answer is __Dial Test Indicator**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dial Test Indicators__ are precision measurement tools used to measure small linear distances.
 
• They work on the principle of magnifying small movements of a stylus or plunger.
 
• The movement is converted into rotational motion of the pointer on a circular scale.
 
• It provides accurate and precise measurements in various mechanical and machining applications.
 
• Commonly used in alignment and calibration tasks in engineering and manufacturing industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pressure Gauge:**
 
 
• Used to measure fluid pressure in a system.
 
• Does not involve converting linear motion into rotary motion.
 
 
 
• **Vernier Caliper:**
 
 
• Used for measuring linear dimensions.
 
• Does not use a pointer or circular scale for measurement.
 
 
 
• **Micrometer:**
 
 
• Used to measure small distances with high precision.
 
• Involves a screw mechanism rather than a plunger and circular scale.
